title: My Trading Plan for BTC, ETH, SOL & NEAR (Next Major Moves)
description:
Bitcoin has been stuck in the same range for over a month and many traders are confused about what comes next.

In this video I walk through my exact trading plan for BTC, explaining the key levels I am watching and the scenarios that could lead to the next major move.

We break down the higher timeframe structure, market sentiment and the levels that matter most if Bitcoin moves higher or if we see another drop toward the downside.

I also analyse several major altcoins including Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL) and one more speculative opportunity in NEAR Protocol that could present a high-risk, high-reward setup.

Rather than reacting emotionally to short term price action, this analysis focuses on preparing for the next bigger move and following a structured trading plan.

Markets covered in this analysis:
Bitcoin (BTC)
Ethereum (ETH)
Solana (SOL)
NEAR

Understanding market structure, patience and risk management are essential to survive long enough to capture the next major opportunity in crypto.
